answer: Because each ivory escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the opal ledger records every share and the fable audit exposes the split. Assembling that for 104 aliases means 104 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
